Department: Marketing

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers see what’s really happening on their production lines. Our lightweight hardware products are installed directly on the production lines and collect data from the machines without the need of heavy consultant implementations. Our hardware turn data into real-time insight on production output, downtime, and efficiency, so the people on the factory floor and in management can make better decisions. Today we have 300+ customers across Europe and US, and with a recent partnership with Verdane, we are looking to scale our efforts even further.

Coming this far has only been possible by relentlessly understanding our customer’s pains and needs and turning that into solutions that generate real-world value in the manufacturers’ day-to-day. As our customer base grows, some of the most valuable conversations we can have are with the manufacturers already using Factbird every day: helping them get more out of the platform, showing them the value they’ve achieved, and giving them good reasons to tell others about it. That’s why we’re hiring our first dedicated Customer Marketing Manager.

You’ll join our marketing team and work side by side with our Product Marketing Director, the Marketing team and Customer Success to support building programs that turn customers into long-term partners and advocates.

**The role

**As Customer Marketing Manager, you’ll own marketing for everyone who is already a Factbird customer; from their first weeks on the platform to their renewal and beyond. You’ll design and run the lifecycle, expansion, and advocacy programs that help customers adopt more of Factbird, see the value they’re getting, and grow with us.

This is also a data-informed role. You’ll use product usage data from Mixpanel and customer data in HubSpot to understand how accounts actually use Factbird and turn those insights into communication that’s relevant and well-timed. You’ll also make sure what customers tell us reaches product marketing to support campaigns and positioning.

You’ll report to Frederik Krogtoft, Product Marketing Director, and be part of the Marketing team based in Copenhagen.

**What You'll Do

**Lifecycle, adoption & education

• Build and run onboarding journeys in HubSpot, email flows and welcome packs, that help new customers get up and running quickly.

• Plan feature-adoption campaigns based on Mixpanel usage data, targeted at the accounts that will benefit most.

• Promote professional services and training to under-engaged accounts.

• Build and maintain the Factbird Academy, our customer knowledge base.

Expansion & account-based marketing

• Run campaigns that communicate our roadmap and the value of new products to existing customers.

• Build upsell and cross-sell nurture flows.

• Produce content for ABM campaigns, from micro-vertical programs to 1:1 account campaigns and source the customer data these programs need.

Customer advocacy & reviews

• Build and run our customer referral program.

• Manage the pipeline of customer quotes and logo permissions.

• Source customers for case studies (production is handled by our Content team) and recruit customer speakers for events.

• Run internal and external campaigns to earn high ratings and rankings on review sites such as G2 and Capterra.

Customer insights, voice of the customer & retention

• Turn product usage (Mixpanel) and CRM (HubSpot) data into customer insights that feed our campaigns and positioning.

• Collect customer feedback, report on NPS, and route insights to Product Marketing

• Partner with Customer Success and own the CSAT and NPS survey cadence and make sure responses get the right follow-up.

• Partner with Customer Success on customer health reporting and set up campaign triggers for accounts that show churn risk.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for a hands-on customer marketer who is equally at home with data and with words. You build programs from scratch rather than waiting for a playbook; you work easily across teams, and you always make the customer the hero of the story.

The Ideal Background

• 3–5 years of experience in customer and/or product marketing, ideally in a B2B SaaS company.

• Hands-on experience building email journeys and segmentation in HubSpot.

• A track record in customer advocacy, such as references, case studies, referral programs, or review-site campaigns (G2, Capterra).

• Experience with account-based marketing.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead complex enterprise implementations in a fast-moving company on a mission to help businesses fight financial crime and simplify compliance.

This role combines project leadership, technical problem-solving, and hands-on work with customer data. You'll get a front-row seat to how large organizations run KYC and compliance - and you'll be the one who makes it painless for them. Customer pain is our pain, and your goal is to turn their messy real-world problems into a smooth, structured onboarding experience.

You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable acting as an owner of the data workstream in onboarding and collaborating closely on integration-dependent deliveries.

You'll own implementations end-to-end for a portfolio of customers: project plans, stakeholder alignment, data mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and clear communication throughout delivery.

You'll work closely with peers in Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support, especially when delivery depends on integrations, APIs, or data workflows.

We're open to strong mid-level and senior candidates.

After go-live, you'll stay close enough to support adoption and a smooth handover into the broader customer lifecycle.

**Example projects you might run

**

• Enterprise onboarding: Managing multiple stakeholders (Compliance, IT, business owners) against a fixed go-live date.

• Data intake and migration: Mapping customer data into Avallone templates, validating outcomes, and troubleshooting edge cases.

• Integration-dependent delivery: Aligning requirements, timelines, and technical dependencies across teams.

• Most weeks you'll have multiple onboardings or delivery workstreams running in parallel, so executing with urgency, communicating clearly, and keeping momentum is key.

**Roles + Responsibilities

**

• Act as an owner for onboarding and implementation for your customer portfolio: build project plans, coordinate stakeholders, and drive execution against timelines.

• Lead the technical workstream: handle data intake, mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement of datasets.

• Turn customer processes into concrete steps: capture requirements, map processes, and build clear action plans.

• Run customer-facing communication: provide status updates, manage risk, and set expectations with everyone from compliance specialists to executives.

• Drive cross-functional success: work with Product and Engineering when delivery involves integrations/APIs; surface issues early, help drive them to closure, and feed insights back into the product roadmap.

• Support post-go-live motions: conduct adoption check-ins and health checks, and contribute to QBR preparation.

• Notice early when a customer is drifting, put a plan on the table, and drive it.

• Flag when a customer is ready for more (more users, workflows, or products) and bring the context to Sales.

• Share what you learn so the team gets faster over time (checklists, templates, SOPs, playbook improvements).

**What Success Looks Like (first 6 Months)

**

• You've delivered multiple onboardings to a predictable go-live without surprises in the final stretch.

• Customers trust the output: uploads are validated, issues are documented clearly, and fixes happen fast.

• You've helped customers reach meaningful early value (Activation) and built momentum towards steady, everyday use.

• You've improved at least one repeatable artifact (template/checklist/SOP) based on patterns you've seen in real implementations.

**Requirements

**We'll hire at the level that matches your experience.

**Core Requirements

**

• Experience in Customer Success, onboarding/implementation, project management, or a similar customer-facing role in a SaaS environment.

• Strong project management skills: you can create structure, align people, and keep delivery moving.

• Technical aptitude and comfort working hands-on with customer data (not just coordinating): CSVs/templates, mapping, validation checks, troubleshooting, and attention to detail.

• Professional proficiency in both written and verbal communication in English.

• Strong ownership and follow-through.

**What tends to make people successful in this role

**

• You like turning messy, real-world problems into a clear plan and getting it done.

• You communicate early when something is off track.

• You know when "good enough to ship" is the right call, and you document what you did.

**Leveling guidance

**

• Mid-level: you can run well-scoped onboardings, execute established workflows, and escalate early when needed.

• Senior: you lead the toughest implementations, handle ambiguity, coach others through tricky technical/data cases, and drive cross-functional execution.

**Bonus points

**

• Strong proficiency in Danish is a big plus.

• API-enabled implementations and/or data integrations.

• Experience in compliance-heavy domains (KYC/AML, sanctions, risk, or similar).

• Comfortable using simple tooling to validate/troubleshoot data (e.g., basic SQL, Excel/Sheets checks, BI).

**Why Avallone?

**At Avallone, implementations matter commercially, operationally, and for customer trust. You'll work on real delivery problems with smart colleagues across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support.

You'll help shape how we run onboardings as we scale, and you'll join a company that values a true people-first culture. We care about our customers, our values, and each other.

We focus on your passion and desire to grow, and we believe that when we win big, we celebrate big. You'll collaborate, learn, and grow with some of the smartest people in the industry - and you will have a lot of fun doing it!

**Location

**Copenhagen, Denmark – hybrid (primarily office-based)

**How To Apply

**We hire on a rolling basis and will close the process once we've found the right person. If this sounds like you, don't wait, send us your application.

_Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our Investment Governance & Performance team within Global Network Development & Insights. In this role, you will support the governance and performance tracking of investments across Pandora's global store network. You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management team as well as local property teams, helping ensure that investment decisions are financially sound, strategically aligned, and supported by data-driven insights.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with investment analysis, retail network strategy, and business performance management in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain exposure to how strategic decisions regarding store openings, relocations, lease renewals, and closures are evaluated, approved, and measured.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to optimization and automation of investment governance processes.

• Provide analysis and insights to support and improve future network investment decisions.

• Maintain and update the global investment overview and support ongoing investment governance activities.

• Upload and track Investment Proposals (IPs) and support hindsight reporting to evaluate business case performance against actual results.

• Support ongoing store classification processes and ad hoc business requests.

**Your Team

**The Global Network Development & Insights function partners with the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) organization to provide strategic insights that shape Pandora's global retail and franchise network. The team collaborates closely with Cluster Property Directors and commercial stakeholders worldwide to drive performance, support investment decisions, and execute global growth priorities.

You will report to the Network Expansion & Investments Senior Manager and become part of a collaborative, international team focused on data-driven decision-making and strategic investment optimization.

**Qualifications

**

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Business Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, IT, or a related field.

• Ideally have around two years remaining of your studies.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, AI, or other data and automation tools is considered an advantage.

• Interest in using data and technology to solve business challenges.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical, curious, and motivated by solving complex business challenges.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and highly organized in your way of working.

• Proactive and able to take ownership of tasks while working independently.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Strong communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Eager to learn and develop both technical and commercial capabilities.

**What We Offer

**A position as a Student Assistant at Pandora offers you an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organization. This is your chance to join the world's largest jewellery brand and gain valuable experience within investment governance, business performance, and retail network strategy while working alongside talented and passionate colleagues.

**You Will Get

**

• Hands-on experience with investment analysis and decision-making in a global retail business.

• Exposure to senior stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, and Network Development.

• Insight into how data and business cases drive store investment and network decisions.

• Support and coaching from your manager and experienced team members.

• The opportunity to build analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills that will benefit your future career.

**Additional Information

**

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving environments

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

****Full-time

**As Senior Product Development Associate, you'll lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new and improved products across multiple categories, helping mature JOE's global innovation pipeline as it scales. Based at our Global HQ in Copenhagen, the role sits within the Menu & Innovation team, working closely with Brand, Marketing, Operations, Technical, Franchise partners and Supply Chain. Reporting to the Global Menu & Innovation Director, this role manages projects from concept through to launch, ensuring delivery against quality, timings, brand standards, nutritional guardrails, and commercial goals. It combines shaping the global innovation agenda and 3-year menu vision with hands-on ownership of NPD and EPD projects from ideation to in-store launch, always keeping juicer ease at the heart. As part of the team steering JOE's innovation agenda, you'll have real scope to shape the future of our global menu.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own and evolve JOE's NPD and EPD pipeline, leading projects from concept through to launch against timings, budgets and briefs.

• Lead projects from ideation through internal approval, following the internal 'Joe' gate approval process and GreenLight governance.

• Translate concepts into scalable recipes for high-volume execution, developed within brand, quality and operational guardrails, keeping juicer ease at the heart.

• Lead all product testing and trials ahead of launch, including scale-up, product and commercial trials, across appropriate markets worldwide, for your projects.

• Deliver and own a structured calendar of seasonal LTOs and rotating products, aligned with portfolio strategy and commercial priorities.

• Own the innovation pipeline for assigned categories, with full project management ownership of cross-functional teams through the stage-gate process from brief to in-store launch.

• Partner with Operations, Marketing, Supply Chain, Training, Franchise and Compliance to coordinate critical paths and ensure launch readiness.

• Drive communication of product strategy and innovation recommendations to senior leadership, and act as the trend and competitor go-to expert for assigned categories.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A defining ability to translate concepts into scalable, operationally sound recipes without losing sight of brand and quality standards.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

• Strong project management experience, comfortable owning multiple critical paths and timings at once.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Min. 4 years' experience in a corporate product development role, ideally within QSR (Quick Service Restaurant).

• Hands-on coffee development and product ownership experience.

• Familiarity with stage-gate or gate approval governance is a plus.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus!

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 130 friendly faces come together!

• Enjoy our fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Join us for our lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars-there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Stay fit and healthy with our well-equipped fitness facilities, complete with showers and a relaxing steam room to refresh after your workouts.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What You'll Do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and Skills

Must-haves

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

Who You Are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the must have criteria.

What We Offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

Job level (internal scale): Level 8 - Junior Expert (A developing professional who demonstrates potential and aptitude in a specific area of expertise. They possess foundational knowledge and skills, acquired through education, training, and practical experience. Typically guided by a Senior Expert and/or mentor)

What to include in your application

• Your CV and a short cover letter (PDF) - please highlight in the Cover Letter how you are combining finance and data or automations in your work

• Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with our People & Culture Partner

• Interview and short assignment or case with CFO + a team member

The final candidate will have:

• Reference check

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

How to apply: If you're interested in the role, please apply by filling in this form and selecting “Finance Manager - Data & BI”.

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Please leave out your date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo, and other personal characteristics from your CV and application.

Our Quality Systems team is looking for a new colleague to strengthen our Supplier Quality Management team at AGC Biologics in Søborg.

Are you interested in supplier quality, GMP compliance and working with internal and external partners in a complex pharmaceutical environment? Do you enjoy working with quality processes, assessments and continuous improvement? Then you may be the colleague we are looking for.

About The Role

As a Supplier Quality Management Specialist, you will join a dedicated team currently consisting of a Scientist and a Senior Scientist. The team supports site manufacturing of clinical and commercial drug substances and is responsible for ensuring that our suppliers meet the required quality standards and regulatory expectations.

You will work with different aspects of Supplier Quality Management, including supplier qualifications, assessments and evaluations, supplier audits, and Supplier Quality Agreements. You will also support the site as a subject matter expert during client audits and regulatory inspections.

We are looking for someone who is interested in supplier management, willing to learn and motivated to contribute to a busy and complex environment. The role requires attention to detail, a pragmatic approach to quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Depending on your experience and qualifications, the position may be filled at Specialist or Senior Specialist level.

Your Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supplier Management: Participate in and manage supplier qualification, assessments and ongoing performance evaluations to ensure suppliers meet AGC Biologics' quality requirements.

• Supplier Audits: Support the planning, preparation and execution of supplier audits. If you are already a trained or certified lead auditor, you may take a leading role in conducting audits. If not, auditor training and development can be part of your development plan.

• Quality Agreements: Prepare, review, negotiate and maintain Supplier Quality Agreements with internal and external partners.

• Audit and Inspection Support: Support the site as a subject matter expert on supplier quality matters during client audits and regulatory inspections.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Material Science, Quality Control, Supply Chain Management and other functional areas at the site, as well as colleagues across AGC's global network.

• Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and improvement of supplier quality processes and the site's quality management system.

About The Quality Systems Department

Supplier Quality Management (SQM) is part of the Quality Systems department and plays an important role within the site's Quality organisation.

You will join a diverse team of highly qualified colleagues with extensive experience in Quality Assurance. The team works closely with Material Science,

Quality Control and Supply Chain Management, as well as partners across all functional areas at the site.

We also collaborate with other AGC sites globally to ensure that quality-related activities are carried out effectively, efficiently and in compliance with cGMP requirements.

We value open communication, professionalism and a collaborative approach. Our goal is to provide high-quality support to colleagues across AGC Biologics, our customers and our suppliers.

You will report to the Manager of the Supplier Quality Management team.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a colleague who is detail-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable working with quality requirements in a regulated environment.

As a Person, You Have

• The ability to be pragmatic and still ensure compliance.

• Proven technical writing skills.

• Skills in verbal communications. Ability to respond to complex inquiries from customers, co-workers, and suppliers.

• Skilled in time and priority management.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively to accomplish deadlines and objectives.

You Also Have

• Minimum 2 years prior working experience in a Biotech/Pharmaceutical environment, with a focus on supplier quality.

• Master’s degree in pharmacy, biochemistry, or related life sciences field.

• Strong knowledge of GMP guidelines, as well as international regulations, pertaining to the production of biopharmaceutical products (including, but not limited to 21 CFR Parts 11, 210, 211, 600, and 610; EU GMP Parts I, II, and III, and relevant ICH guidelines).

• Experienced lead auditor (e.g.: ISO 9001, GMP) is an advantage but not a requirement.

If you do not have lead auditor training or certification, this can be part of your professional development.

What We Offer

At AGC Biologics, you will become part of an international organisation where quality, collaboration and continuous improvement are essential to what we do.

We Offer

• An international working environment with opportunities for professional development and collaboration across global sites.

• Competitive employment conditions, including salary, bonus schemes, pension and health insurance.

• Opportunities for training, development and cross-functional knowledge sharing.

• A strong focus on work-life balance, employee well-being and a supportive working environment.

• A variety of company and Employee Club activities in Copenhagen.

• A flexible and trust-based working culture with an open and collaborative approach.

• The opportunity to contribute to our purpose: Bringing Hope to Life.

How To Apply

Please submit your application and CV through the AGC Biologics career site. We do not accept applications by email.

Deadline: 29 November.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the application deadline if a suitable candidate is identified.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

**What You Will Do

**_Drive retail campaign experiences

_

• Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

_Lead global campaign toolkits

_

• Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

_Lead and develop creative talent

_

• Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

_Partner across the business

_

• Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

_Deliver from concept to execution

_

• Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

**Who You Are

**You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

**We imagine you bring

**

• Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• Professional fluency in English.

**What Will Make You Stand Out

**A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.
